Conversion Funnel

Turn visits, sign-up starts, profile submissions, and completions into a funnel to find the largest drop-off.

A sequence of user counts and conversion rates that locates drop-off from entry to a target outcome·Out of 1,000 visitors, 620 may start sign-up, 310 submit details, and 280 finish. A funnel shows how many remain at each step. Mismatched event definitions, time windows, or user scopes can make the shape misleading.

Find the largest loss as sign-up counts narrow
Example data · one user scope · 7 days
Visit1,000100%
Start62062%
Submit31050%
Complete28090%
Investigate firstStart → Submit

Lowest step conversion. Verify tracking before investigating the page and rules.

How a conversion funnel provides reliable clues

Define steps and the success outcome: Each step needs a real trackable action and an order that matches the question.

Use one user and time definition: Deduplication, entry rules, and observation windows change the result and must remain consistent.

Location is not cause: A funnel shows where to investigate; interface, rule, technical, and motivation causes still need evidence.

What people often confuse

A User Flow describes the allowed path. A Conversion Funnel counts how many people actually reach each step. A flow can define funnel steps but cannot replace data.
